name: The True Masters
label: Quest
description: The True Masters: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: This is grim news, friend. To discover that our mortal enemies are merely pawns of a much greater threat is disheartening. There is no possible way that Lakeshire could survive an attack from both the Blackrock orcs and the black dragonflight. Should Lakeshire fall to this menace, Darkshire would fall next, and then what? Goldshire? Stormwind itself?
You must take this information to Highlord Bolvar Fordragon in Stormwind at once! If this does not merit the aid of Stormwind, nothing will and all is lost.

clips.title: Progress
paras: What brings you to Stormwind Keep?
